**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refresh filter-bar state after native filters change**

When callers retain `layout = dashboard.reset_layout()` and then add native filters through `dashboard.json_metadata`, the layout keeps the newly cached `False` value even when subsequent `layout.add_markdown(..., height="auto")` calls should account for a vertical filter bar. This is the cached-layout construction pattern shown in the README. Wrapping content can consequently receive an undersized height; saving then synchronizes the flag to `True` and warns or raises `SizingError` for the automatically sized component. Previously the conservative vertical-bar default handled this case. Resolve the current metadata when estimating, or invalidate the cached state when filters or orientation change, rather than relying on another access to `dashboard.position`.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L125-L127](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/b39aa0919685a78eb93e0ababa65ec5810dddca9/AGENTS.md#L125-L127)
